title: Reconcile Prisma migration ledger. Do not redeploy.
brief: Lead is Grok. Motif stands down. Run from Beexly/Sports packages/db with DIRECT_URL already in the Windows environment. Do not print the connection string. Do not delete a table. Do not run prisma migrate deploy. Do not redeploy sports-web. Read docs/ops/MIGRATION_LEDGER_RECONCILIATION_RUNBOOK.md. The July name list may be stale. Live ledger wins. Step 1: npx prisma migrate diff --from-url DIRECT_URL --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma. Step 2: select migration_name, finished_at, rolled_back_at from _prisma_migrations. Write both to outbox/from-opencode/prisma-ledger-2026-10-08.txt and push that file to this repo. If the diff is not No difference detected, stop. If it is clean, mark applied only migrations that exist in prisma/migrations and are missing from the ledger, then delete only ledger rows whose files are gone. Backup the select first.
